recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, forced-perspective diorama featuring a metallic-skinned humanoid figure at a desk, a reclining geometric figure on a red chaise, and a background wall filled with neon-lit symbols and film-strip borders, all set upon a yellow and black checkered floor.
coreVisualRelationships: The metallic head acts as a massive foreground anchor on the right third.
Laser-like lines connect the reclining figure's eyes to the neon wall.
The checkered floor provides a receding grid that establishes deep spatial depth.
The white border frames the central square image, separating it from the display typography.
coreInvariants: Metallic texture on the primary character
Neon glow effects on background elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The large metallic head is positioned in the extreme foreground right; the reclining figure is central; the neon wall occupies the left background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized metallic head with green glasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the metallic head, follows the desk to the reclining figure, then follows the light beams to the neon wall on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick white border surrounding the central image provides significant breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow and black (floor) and white (border) define the structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and greens in the background create atmospheric depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (chaise and lips) and neon green/pink (signage) provide focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon and red elements against a dark, moody interior background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high-contrast black and white foundations

letterConstructionRules: Top text must be extremely wide (extended) with heavy horizontal emphasis.
Bottom text must be a fluid, connected handwriting script with varying line weights.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the top text is simplified to a hook.
The script text features long, sweeping horizontal tails.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, mechanical geometric sans and a loose, organic humanistic script.

preserve: Ultra-extended width of the top font
Handwritten quality of the bottom font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy horizontal weight and wide stance of the top text.
Captures the energetic, connected brush-stroke feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist diorama in a square format. Include a yellow and black checkered floor in forced perspective. On the right, a large metallic-textured head with green glasses. In the center, a geometric figure on a red chaise. On the left, a wall with neon signs and a film-strip border. Surround the entire square image with a thick white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply an ultra-extended bold sans-serif font in the top white margin, centered. Apply a black handwritten script in the bottom right white margin, slightly angled.

verificationChecks: Is the image perfectly square within a white frame?
Is the top text extremely wide and horizontally stretched?
Does the floor use a high-contrast yellow/black checker pattern?
Is the metallic texture on the foreground head visible?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Tactile, sculptural quality in the characters
Clear separation between the image and the white border

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text does not touch the central image.
Ensure the metallic head has a distinct hammered or foil-like texture.
Verify the light beams are thin and sharp.
Confirm the top text is centered and the bottom text is right-aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Diorama + Forced Perspective + Checkered Floor + Extended Sans/Script Pairing + White Border Frame
